description: Crystals over time from Costelloe's degree table: this year's crystal from the secondary-progressed Sun (about one crystal per year of life, with the ages each one starts), this month's from the progressed Moon, the day's crystal (the transiting Sun's degree), each planet's crystal at the moment, and when Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto or Chiron stand on one of the person's natal crystal degrees in the coming window. Western tropical practice, separate from Jyotish.

asOf.description: ISO date or date-time; defaults to now

place.description: Catalogue query or display label when explicit coordinates are supplied

timezone.description: Required IANA timezone when explicit coordinates are supplied, for example Asia/Kolkata

timezoneOffset.description: Optional fallback offset; derived from timezone and the requested local date when omitted

name: calculate_crystal_timing
title: Crystal astrology over time (Western, tropical)
